Open MOTIS Web UI

Source: R/diagnostics.R
motis_open_ui.Rd

Opens the MOTIS web interface for a running server in the default browser.

motis_open_ui(server = NULL, host = "127.0.0.1", port = 8080L)

Arguments

server

An optional processx::process object from motis_start_server(). If provided, host and port are inferred from the server's command line arguments.

host

A string. The server's host address. Defaults to "127.0.0.1".

port

An integer. The server's port. Defaults to 8080.

Value

Invisibly returns the URL that was opened.
